## What it can do

Every command, flag, default, environment variable and the role or scope each needs is in
`src/commands.ts` — the one table `supi help`, `supi help <verb>` and the published reference
(<https://docs.superpipeline.dev/reference/cli/>) are all rendered from. `src/reference.test.ts` fails
when `index.ts` handles a verb, sub-verb or flag the table does not list, or when the committed pages
under `docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/cli/` are stale. After changing a command:

```sh
pnpm -F @superpipeline/cli reference     # regenerate the pages, then commit them
```

It renders the server's decisions rather than granting authority itself. A person acts with their
own workspace role; under the Organization plane that is their membership, the same one the web app
reads. Staffing agents, editing capabilities and changing the fleet link are not CLI verbs.

A person's credential and an agent's are never interchangeable (see above). **401** means the
credential was not accepted; **403** means the server refused that operation with the caller's
authority.

`src/commands.ts` — the one table `supi help`, `supi help <verb>` and the published reference
(<https://docs.superpipeline.dev/reference/cli/>) are all rendered from. `src/reference.test.ts` fails
when `index.ts` handles a verb, sub-verb or flag the table does not list, or when the committed pages
under `docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/cli/` are stale. After changing a command:

```sh
pnpm -F @superpipeline/cli reference     # regenerate the pages, then commit them
```

It renders the server's decisions rather than granting authority itself. A person acts with their
own workspace role; under the Organization plane that is their membership, the same one the web app
reads. Staffing agents, editing capabilities and changing the fleet link are not CLI verbs.

A person's credential and an agent's are never interchangeable (see above). **401** means the
credential was not accepted; **403** means the server refused that operation with the caller's
authority.

credential was not accepted; **403** means the server refused that operation with the caller's
authority.

reads. Staffing agents, editing capabilities and changing the fleet link are not CLI verbs.

credential was not accepted; **403** means the server refused that operation with the caller's
authority.

`src/commands.ts` — the one table `supi help`, `supi help <verb>` and the published reference
(<https://docs.superpipeline.dev/reference/cli/>) are all rendered from. `src/reference.test.ts` fails
when `index.ts` handles a verb, sub-verb or flag the table does not list, or when the committed pages
under `docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/cli/` are stale. After changing a command:

```sh
pnpm -F @superpipeline/cli reference     # regenerate the pages, then commit them
```

It renders the server's decisions rather than granting authority itself. A person acts with their
own workspace role; under the Organization plane that is their membership, the same one the web app
reads. Staffing agents, editing capabilities and changing the fleet link are not CLI verbs.

A person's credential and an agent's are never interchangeable (see above). **401** means the
credential was not accepted; **403** means the server refused that operation with the caller's
authority.
